Our Story

About Al-Hayaat Catering

Founded by Mr. Sohail Khan, Al-Hayaat Catering is one of the most trusted names and among the Best Wedding Catering Services. We serve sumptuous food to fulfill your each and every catering need. From catering for your dream wedding to serving for your special occasions like Shadi, Walima, Aqeeqa, Niyaz, and Manjha, we can customize the entire food experience for you and your guests.

It's our privilege under the leadership of Mr. Sohail Khan to provide an unforgettable experience to your taste buds and excellent service that makes your function a grand success!

Why Choose Al-Hayaat?

  • Founded & Managed by Mr. Sohail Khan
  • Tailored Menus for Shadi, Walima & Aqeeqa
  • Professional & Courteous Serving Staff
  • Strict 100% Halal & Hygiene Standards
Services

Our Catering Services

Specialized catering for all traditional Islamic functions and celebrations.

Shadi & Walima Catering

Grand wedding feasts, Walima banquets, and customized Dastarkhwan dining.

Aqeeqa Catering Services

Blessed newborn celebrations with traditional recipes and pure 100% Halal ingredients.

Niyaz & Milad Gatherings

Spiritual gatherings served with traditional sweets, sherbet, and wholesome meals.

Manjha & Engagement Parties

Vibrant pre-wedding setups with delightful starters and refreshing drinks.

Family Feasts & Gatherings

Delightful meals for your family and friends during special domestic celebrations.

Large Scale & Corporate Events

Large scale professional outdoor and community feast catering solutions.
